summary: But that is not an attack. Just reality. Fact that I am off to cut the Little League fields is racist too. I have the privilege to volunteer, spend way too much money on kid gear, town has the space for fields and parks, etc.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: But that is not an attack. Just reality. Fact that I am off to cut the Little League fields is racist too. I have the privilege to volunteer, spend way too much money on kid gear, town has the space for fields and parks, etc.
